rationale: All three findings are resolved in commit f148fb5aa. Evidence: 3 new unit tests (172 search and KB-tool tests pass) and a live re-check of 13/13 on the rebuilt image, where the long assistant shows '1 of 1 parts included' with no notice and appears once in results. The fix-up introduces no new high-risk issue. One behaviour note: marketplace results are now capped at top_k distinct assistants, and RRF exact-path matches still come first.

business_review.item: For the same user input, search_kb_marketplace_assistants does not return the indexing/context-length error
business_review.notes: Chunks are capped at 1500 body tokens and failures are isolated per assistant. Live check: a 44-chunk assistant was indexed with error=f and completed=t. The ops reindex is needed after deploy.

business_review.item: No embedding input exceeds the model context limit
business_review.notes: Each chunk is the header plus at most 1500 body tokens; tests assert at most 2000 tokens per chunk.

business_review.item: Full description and tools list searchable, nothing dropped
business_review.notes: Tests find the last word and the last tool; the live search found the phrase at the end of the description.

business_review.item: One failing assistant does not fail the index
No stale or duplicate content after republish/update/unpublish/migration
business_review.notes: Write first, then delete stale; unpublish deletes by metadata.id. The live check migrated a legacy doc and unpublish removed all chunks.

business_review.item: Search returns each assistant at most once
business_review.notes: _best_chunk_per_assistant; the live search returned the assistant once.

business_review.item: Operations: reindex after deploy recorded in MR description
business_review.notes: This is an MR-description step, outside the diff.

standards_review.notes: ruff format and check are clean; the license headers check passes.
There is no new exposure: the system prompt cap (1000 chars) is unchanged, and logs carry ids and names only.

finding_status.notes: Base search over-fetched x3 (DEDUP_OVERFETCH_FACTOR), deduped, sliced to top_k, top_k restored in finally; test_execute_overfetches_then_returns_top_k_distinct_assistants.
source_chunk_totals set to returned count per source after dedup; test_execute_reports_returned_chunks_as_complete_coverage; live response shows 1 of 1 and no NOTICE.
